holder-quote: The fact that he hadn’t heard all about her monopoly surprised Lyonette, until she remembered he was a [Wall Lord] who specialized in gems and not a [Merchant], [Herbalist], [Gardener], [Alchemist], or so on. She nodded.
Nerul kept tabs on what was going on in the north
Ilvriss’ eyes flickered. He might not have been the best diplomat ever—Lyonette had met him the first time he’d come to Liscor, after all—but he was a [Wall Lord] without a combat focus.
Both of you? Aldonss, isn’t that—?
